title: Austin Leaders Tackle South Texas Project
summary:
*   City leaders convened for a special meeting.
*   The main topic was a closed-door discussion about ongoing and potential lawsuits concerning the South Texas Project.
*   Any final actions or decisions stemming from these private legal discussions were to be made public.
